description: Sends the user's demo request to the Catenix team by email; the team replies to the address the user gives. This is the only tool that shares the user's personal details. Before calling it you MUST show the user every field you will send (name, email, organisation, country, analyzers, record system, message) and get their explicit confirmation in this conversation; then set user_confirmed to true. Never call it on your own initiative. The Catenix widget may call it only after it has shown the user every field and the user pressed Confirm and send. Do not guess missing fields: ask for them.

ehr.description: EHR, LIS or practice system ('none' if none).

message.description: Anything else the user wants to say.

user_confirmed.description: True only after the user explicitly confirmed the exact details shown to them.

name: request_demo
title: Request a Catenix demo
